ghats.name: Western Ghats
ghats.description: The Western Ghats, also known as Sahyadri, is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. It is one of the world's eight hottest biodiversity hotspots.

ghats.name: Eastern Ghats
ghats.description: The Eastern Ghats are a discontinuous range of mountains along the eastern coast of India. They are older and more eroded than the Western Ghats.

ghats.name: Varanasi Ghats
ghats.description: The ghats of Varanasi are a series of steps leading down to the Ganges river. They are the spiritual heart of Hinduism.

ghats.name: Rishikesh Ghats
ghats.description: The ghats of Rishikesh on the Ganges are famous for yoga, meditation, and adventure sports. Rishikesh is known as the 'Yoga Capital of the World'.
facts: Ram Jhula and Lakshman Jhula bridges
Beatles visited Maharishi Mahesh Yogi here

ghats.name: Haridwar Ghats
ghats.description: Haridwar is one of the seven holiest places in Hinduism. The Har Ki Pauri ghat is the most sacred spot where the Ganges enters the plains.
facts: Har Ki Pauri — most sacred ghat
